_comment: L2 Hostility difficulty for the Two Lives dimensions (merged with the jar's overworld/nether/end files; keys do not collide).
Mob level = round((dim base + biome base + distanceFactor * blocks from 0,0 + section bonus + scale * player level + gauss * variation) * factor), then capped by maxLevel.
Before this file every ttl:* dimension fell back to defaultLevelBase/Var/Scale (20 / 16 / 1.5): level 20 +-16 at random plus 1.5x the player level, which is how Trial mobs one-shot people.

levelMap: per-dimension base. levelDefaultTraits: one catch-all entity config per dimension (no 'entities' = applies to every mob without its own L2H entity config) for the level cap, trait count and damage scale.
Mobs with a global L2H entity config (bosses.json: ender_dragon, wither, warden, elder_guardian, piglin_brute) keep that config instead of the catch-all.

ttl:mortal_realm._comment: Life 1 overworld: level cap 100 (was 40, issue #144: L2H traits unlock at their own min levels, 20 to 600, and most trait drops need the level 50-100 traits; 40 left only the six cheapest). Levels still grow from 0 at Wayfarer's Rest with distance from 0,0 (+6 per 1000 blocks) and the soul's own L2H level, so the hard mobs are the far ones. Max 3 traits (was 2), half the per-level damage bonus kept: one life, a Human body.

ttl:mortal_nether._comment: Life 1 nether: level cap 150 (was 50, #144), max 4 traits (was 3), half the per-level damage bonus.

ttl:mortal_end._comment: Life 1 end: level cap 200 (was 60, #144), max 4 traits (was 3), half the per-level damage bonus.

ttl:spirit_corridor._comment: Trials of the Soul: no L2H at all, trials.toml is the balance. apply_chance 0 already stops leveling; cap 1, no random traits and zero damage/health scaling are the backstop for the curio cases that force 'full chance' (Curse of Pride, Abyssal Thorn).
